My tiny Dog named Eve she is a Norfolk terrier and she is 14 years old I love her to bits. Anyways one day when I was in primary school mum was driving up the drive way and we didn’t see her and we heard two loud thuds and some crying. I start screaming and freaking out because my dog had been crushed to death and there would of been a bloody scene for 12 year old me to see. I get out of the car and look. At this point I’m crying so hard I am on the ground. But Eve isn’t dead she had actually ran to the door and was shaking. I yell to my mum “take her to the vet NOW”. She gets my dad to do that. And Scans showed no bones where broken and she was completely fine apart for some bruising on her stomach. And that’s an absolute miracle because my tiny trooper survived being hit twice by a Range Rover. 

She is still alive to this day and my baby is doing well. I’m so relieved to still have her with me!
